The '''D-10 Repeating Annihilator''' was a type of personal [[Repeating blaster cannon/Legends|repeating blaster cannon]] produced during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The D-10 Repeating Annihilator first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] released by [[BioWare]].<ref name="TOR" />
